title: Bento Material UI & Navigation Overhaul (v0.4.16)
message: Includes modern Bento squircle cards for library materials, eliminated unexpected floating bubble overlay triggers, and unified Back to Home navigation across all quiz flows.
changelog:
• Premium Bento Squircle Cards: Complete redesign of learning material cards with 22dp squircle curvature, dual-tone preview frame, category tag, and quiz readiness badge.
• Navigation Streamlining: Removed redundant 'Return to Reading' buttons and unified all exit/completion routes to clear-top 'Back to Home'.
• Floating Bubble Service Defense: Prevented unwanted floating bubble popups on exit by checking user preferences and active service state.
• Quiz History Material Tagging: Added visual differentiators for Reading Comprehension quizzes and full-width Back to Home action button.
